name: Tallowpup
concept: A stumpy wax-coated pup whose stubby tail is a flickering tallow candle that warms everything it curls against.
visual: Chunky cream-and-butter-yellow puppy body, ink nose, a single pale candle-flame tail with a soft wax drip; big round eyes; reads as one warm blob at 32px.
hook: The single candle-tail is irresistibly cute — kids will want to protect the little flame.

name: Tallowcrest
concept: A mid-sized candle-hound with a crown of five dripping tallow flames that shift colour depending on its mood.
visual: Robust tawny dog silhouette, wax-drip markings down the haunches, a starburst of five pastel-hued candle-flames crowning the head; distinct and bold at 48px.
hook: The mood-colour flames make it feel alive — a warm ally that visibly cares.

name: Chandrek
concept: A great candlewood hound whose entire mane is a cathedral of living candles, radiating warm golden light that soothes nearby kin.
visual: Large, dignified canine silhouette; back and mane bristle with tall tapers in cream, gold, and amber; pooling light halos the outline; dramatic yet soft at 64px.
signature_idea: Warm Vigil — buffs allies' Special Defense for two turns
hook: An apex hound made of living light — the kind of kin you want walking beside you in the dark.

name: Wickmoth
concept: A small ember-winged moth that navigates by following warm light and scorches anything it bumps into by accident.
visual: Tiny round fuzzy moth body in ash-grey, wings tipped in orange-to-yellow ember gradients, two long antennae with spark-dot tips; reads as a fluttering silhouette at 32px.
hook: The classic 'dangerous but clumsy' charm — a burny little moth you can't help but root for.

name: Scorchwing
concept: A magnificent ember-moth with broad, vein-lit wings that trail blazing filaments and leave a shower of sparks with every wingbeat.
visual: Wide, spread-wing moth silhouette; upper wings are deep charcoal laced with bright ember veins, lower wings trail glowing filaments; menacing and beautiful at 64px.
signature_idea: Flare Scatter — hits all opponents with low-power fire sparks
hook: From clumsy little Wickmoth to this gorgeous blazing terror — one of the most satisfying glow-ups in Vesperholm.

name: Ignibble
concept: A chubby ember-sprite that looks like a floating coal with tiny limbs; constantly nibbles on flammable things and hiccups smoke.
visual: Near-spherical dark-grey body with orange cracks like cooling lava, stubby arms and legs, beady white eyes; very simple shape that reads perfectly at 32px.
hook: The hiccuping coal-sprite that accidentally sets things on fire — pure early-game comedy gold.

name: Cindrok
concept: A squat obsidian-plated bruiser whose body is a mass of cooling magma-rock ridged with glowing orange fissures; slow but unstoppable.
visual: Broad low-slung boulder-kin silhouette, black basalt plating with lava-orange glowing cracks along every joint, heavy limbs; reads as a tank at 64px.
signature_idea: Magma Crush — slow but devastatingly powerful physical Ember move
hook: A living volcano that waddles — the comedy of something so slow being so terrifying.

name: Embrix
concept: A quick little ember-lizard that skitters across warm stones, leaving tiny scorch marks with each foot that briefly spark and fade.
visual: Slim, quick-looking lizard in rust-orange with a glowing stripe down the spine, small bright eyes, long tail with an ember tip; lithe silhouette reads fast at 32px.
hook: Fast and feisty — the scrappy little lizard that always seems one step ahead.

name: Scaldrak
concept: A sleek, long-bodied fire-drake that races along the ground and leaves a searing trail wherever its belly grazes the earth.
visual: Elongated low-slung drake silhouette, deep ember-red scales with bright gold underbelly, swept-back horns, a whip-like tail; long horizontal read at 64px.
signature_idea: Searing Trail — sets the field terrain on fire, damaging switch-ins
hook: The satisfying payoff of that little scorch-lizard — now a ground-scorching drake.

name: Fluffern
concept: A fluffy round fire-sparrow that puffs up when alarmed and releases a burst of hot air and downy embers in all directions.
visual: Plump round bird, warm amber-orange fluff, tiny beak, stubby wings with flame-tips, huge bright eyes; a perfect round silhouette at 32px.
hook: Unbearably poofy and warm — it looks like a flying coal-furred pillow.

name: Cindervane
concept: A swift, sleek fire-bird that dives at speed and uses the friction of the air to fan its own plumage into a brilliant living corona.
visual: Streamlined bird silhouette, deep red-orange body, long swept tail-feathers with flame tips, talon-streaks glowing gold; fast and elegant at 64px.
signature_idea: Tailspin Blaze — speed stat boosts after using a fire move
hook: The transformation from poofy ball to this sleek racer is a true delight.

name: Ashlette
concept: A tiny ash-fairy that drifts on warm updrafts, trailing grey motes; when it sneezes, it blasts a puff of concentrated fire-dust.
visual: Near-translucent teardrop fairy body in pale smoke-grey with a tiny ember core, gossamer ash-wings, two stub arms; minimal but charming at 32px.
hook: The sneeze that accidentally launches a fireball — endearingly powerful.

name: Embrift
concept: A swirling ash-sprite that has grown a permanent vortex of superheated cinders around its body, moving like a living dust-devil.
visual: Hovering humanoid silhouette ringed by a spinning debris-halo of cinders, orange core glowing at the heart, long wispy arms; dynamic at 48px.
hook: A tiny fairy has become a swirling pillar of flame — awe-inducing mid-stage transformation.

name: Pyriven
concept: A towering cinder-wraith whose body is a column of black smoke wreathed in fierce orange-white flames, haunting the ruins of old hearths.
visual: Tall ghostly pillar silhouette: smoke-black upper body fading into blazing fire-orange lower half, spectral arms, hollow bright eyes; striking contrast at 64px.
signature_idea: Charcoal Hex — special Dark move that also applies a burn
hook: The ash-fairy grew into a ghost made of fire — spooky, beautiful, and unforgettable.

name: Blazethorn
concept: The final form of the starter Vulpyre: a proud, sleek fire-fox whose mane erupts into a blazing crown of tall flame-spines, channelling its hearth-bond into devastating focused special blasts.
visual: Upright fox silhouette, deep ember-red coat, cream underbelly, mane erupting upward in a spike-crown of orange-to-white flames; regal and fast at 64px.
signature_idea: Crown Blaze — channelled fire beam boosted by bond strength; Blazethorn exclusive
hook: The Vulpyre you picked as a tiny cub grew into this gorgeous, powerful guardian — the payoff of your whole journey together.

name: Glowder
concept: A squat cave-slug that secretes a thick luminescent slime insulating it from heat; it cheerfully eats warm coal and glows a faint amber.
visual: Wide low oval slug body in orange-brown, glossy slime sheen, two blunt eyestalks with tiny white pupils, short stubby tail; simple low silhouette at 32px.
hook: The brave little coal-eater that refuses to be moved — a tiny defensive powerhouse hiding in the mine.

name: Emburge
concept: A barrel-bodied magma-snail whose shell has hardened into a volcano-cone of solid obsidian, with a permanent lava-flow vent at the peak.
visual: Massive round body, jet-black volcanic shell with a glowing lava vent at the crown, short powerful limbs; slow-but-indestructible silhouette at 64px.
signature_idea: Obsidian Shell — reduces incoming physical damage significantly for one turn
hook: A slug became a living volcano — the most satisfying defensive transformation in the mine.

name: Sparrig
concept: A frantic little mine-rat whose static-charged fur crackles with tiny sparks whenever it gets excited — which is basically always.
visual: Wiry round-headed rodent, singed orange-brown fur that stands on end, bright static-spark wisps around the body, big ears; active and messy at 32px.
hook: An anxious little spark-rat that can't help but zap things — chaotic and loveable.

name: Voltfur
concept: A bristling fire-and-lightning beast whose pelt is permanently lit by plasma-channels, able to trigger burn and paralysis simultaneously.
visual: Robust hunched predator silhouette, ember-red coat streaked with bright blue-white lightning channels, mane of standing spark-tipped quills; electric-dangerous at 64px.
signature_idea: Plasma Coat — chance to burn and paralyse attacker on contact
hook: The chaotic spark-rat grew into the one kin that makes opponents afraid to touch it.

name: Scorchite
concept: A marble-sized wandering coal-sprite with a single bright eye; it rolls into warm crevices in Cinderhead Mine and hums contentedly.
visual: Near-perfect sphere, dull black coal texture with a single amber-glow eye, two tiny round feet; the simplest possible round silhouette at 32px.
hook: The smallest, round-est creature in the mine — impossibly cute in its simplicity.

name: Coalump
concept: The little coal-sprite has absorbed enough heat to grow limbs and a second eye; its body now cracks open in starbursts of orange light when it attacks.
visual: Lumpy rounded torso, short sturdy limbs, two glowing eyes, body covered in expanding crack-pattern glow lines; reads as power building at 48px.
hook: Watching those cracks spread as it gets stronger makes every battle feel like building toward an explosion.

name: Pyrolith
concept: A crystallised magma-titan whose body has solidified into angular obsidian with a blazing reactor core visible through the translucent chest-plate.
visual: Tall imposing angular silhouette, jet obsidian faceted body, a glowing diamond-orange core blazing through a transparent chest section, jutting shoulder-spurs; monolithic at 64px.
signature_idea: Core Breach — massive single-hit fire blast; user loses some HP as recoil
hook: A tiny coal rolling in the dark became this godlike obsidian titan — the mine's final secret.

name: Hearthkit
concept: A small round hearth-fox kitten that nests inside unused fireplaces and glows soft amber when it purrs; it smells permanently of woodsmoke and cinnamon.
visual: Round-bodied kitten, deep apricot coat with cream markings, curled ember-glow tail, closed-eyed happy expression; warm and cosy silhouette at 32px.
hook: The kitten that lives in the fireplace and purrs — every kid wants one as a bedroom companion.

name: Warmantis
concept: The hearth-kitten has grown into a luminous fire-cat that forms a bond so deep it can project its warmth as a visible golden aura shielding its trainer.
visual: Elegant long-bodied cat silhouette, warm gold-and-cream coat, a soft luminous aura halo, ember-tip tail; graceful and glowing at 64px.
signature_idea: Hearth-Oath — dramatically raises ally's Defense and Sp.Defense for 3 turns; usable once per battle
hook: The bond evolution payoff — it literally becomes an aura of love around you.

name: Clucker
concept: A strutting ember-chick with a bright red comb and scorching tiny talons; it challenges anything twice its size and somehow always survives.
visual: Plump round chick silhouette, orange feathers, oversized fiery red comb, tiny defiant wings, bold dark eyes; ridiculous confidence at 32px.
hook: The ridiculous bravado of a tiny chicken challenging the world — endearing and hilarious.

name: Infernock
concept: A blazing rooster whose tail-feathers are literal pillars of fire and whose battle-crow shakes dust from ceilings; genuinely terrifying in a fight.
visual: Tall proud rooster silhouette, deep crimson-and-gold feathers, a massive fan of burning tail-plumes, fierce eyes; dramatic and imposing at 64px.
signature_idea: War Crow — physical Ember move that lowers the opponent's Attack
hook: That gobby chick grew into this — a fire-tailed colossus that commands respect.

name: Smoldrop
concept: A sentient teardrop-shaped ember that rolls and bounces around hearths, carrying warmth to cold corners; fragile but fast.
visual: Smooth teardrop shape, warm orange with a bright white-hot core, tiny face near the rounded top, no limbs; pure shape at 32px.
hook: A tiny droplet of pure fire with a face — the sweetest possible thing.

name: Tindrix
concept: A spindly stick-insect made of living tinder and dry-wood whose whole body crackles when it rubs its forelegs together like a living matchstick.
visual: Thin angular stick-bug silhouette, bark-brown body with bright orange ember-glow at every joint, antennae tipped with sparks; distinctive angles at 32px.
hook: A walking match-stick that ignites itself — a genius little design that rewards a second look.

name: Blaztwig
concept: A tall, graceful fire-mantis sculpted from charred heartwood, whose folded arms snap open like igniting kindling when it attacks.
visual: Elongated bipedal silhouette, charcoal-black hardwood body, swept-back flame-spike head-crest, glowing orange joint-orbs, long praying arms; elegant and dangerous at 64px.
signature_idea: Kindling Strike — special fire move with bonus damage on first use each battle
hook: A twig became a charcoal deity — unexpected, beautiful, surprising.

name: Cinderveil
concept: A ghost-like ember-kin found in the burned-out lower galleries of Cinderhead Mine — a smear of dark smoke held together by a single stubborn coal.
visual: Tall wispy smoke-form silhouette, charcoal-dark body with orange coal burning at the chest-centre, tattered veil-like edges; ghostly and moody at 48px.
signature_idea: Smoke Screen — Dark-typed status move that lowers accuracy and applies confusion
hook: The haunted air of the mine made visible — the dread of dark corners hiding old fire.

name: Glowtoad
concept: A plump hot-spring toad that absorbs heat from warm mineral pools in the mine and radiates it back as a soothing amber glow from its warty skin.
visual: Squat toad silhouette, mustard-orange bumpy skin with glowing amber warts, wide flat mouth, stubby toes; reads as round and steady at 32px.
hook: The goofy friendly toad that happens to be an impenetrable warm wall.

name: Magmoad
concept: A massive mineral-crusted toad whose skin has hardened into crystallised magma-plate; it sits immovably in the mine's deepest hot springs and is nearly impossible to shift.
visual: Massive wide toad silhouette, black-and-orange crystalline plate-skin, lava-glow seams at the joints, deep patient eyes; supremely immovable at 64px.
signature_idea: Stone Soak — absorbs a super-effective physical hit, halving its damage
hook: The most serene and unstoppable kin in the mine — nothing moves this toad.

name: Ashwing
concept: A small ash-bird that inhabits the mine's ventilation shafts, riding the updrafts of hot exhaust and scattering fine cinders in its wake.
visual: Slim swallow-like bird, pale ash-grey body, ember-orange wing-tips, long forked tail with cinder motes trailing behind; reads as airborne and swift at 32px.
hook: A bird made of mine-exhaust — wild and surprising in the nicest way.

name: Pyrestrel
concept: A sweeping fire-hawk that rides superheated thermals out of the mine, its wing-trailing cinders forming a visible comet-arc across the sky.
visual: Wide-wingspan raptor silhouette, deep charcoal-and-orange feathers, dramatic swept-back crest-plume, trailing ember arc behind every wing-beat; majestic at 64px.
signature_idea: Cinder Dive — boosted speed-based fire attack after two turns of set-up
hook: The ash-bird became a comet — tracing that arc across the screen never gets old.

name: Embermite
concept: A tiny eight-legged ember-spider that weaves webs of hardened glassy char in warm corners and snares anything that blunders through.
visual: Small round body over eight delicate legs, amber-orange body with tiny coal-black markings, silken char-thread trailing behind; creepy-cute at 32px.
hook: Creepy spider plus warm fire equals unexpectedly adorable — a surprising keeper.

name: Charlock
concept: A large shadowy ember-spider that constructs vast web-traps of scorching char-silk in the dark; opponents who blunder in find themselves both burning and stuck.
visual: Large angular spider silhouette, black chitin with ember-orange leg-bands and glowing orange eye-cluster, trailing thick web-filaments; menacing at 64px.
signature_idea: Char Web — traps opponent for two turns; may inflict burn on entry
hook: The little creepy spider became a trap-master — the predator lying in the dark corners of the south.

name: Crumblix
concept: A craggy coal-mole that drills through the mine with superheated snout-plates, eating coal and iron ore; tiny but surprisingly hard-hitting.
visual: Stout rounded mole silhouette, coal-black fur, glowing orange snout-plate, oversized digging forelimbs; burly and cute at 32px.
hook: The scrappy little miner who headbutts through walls — small dog energy in a coal-digging body.

name: Bouldrel
concept: A hulking magma-mole encased in a fused suit of iron ore and molten rock, capable of boring through solid stone with a single headbutt.
visual: Wide boulder-armoured mole silhouette, slate-grey ore plating with lava-orange seams, massive rounded head, short powerful arms; an armoured ram at 64px.
signature_idea: Burrow Blast — builds power while underground for a devastating contact move
hook: The little coal-mole becomes an unstoppable living cannonball — utterly satisfying.

name: Lustorch
concept: A magnificent rare lantern-elk whose antlers are branching columns of pure white-hot fire, said to appear only on the night of a relit Ember constellation.
visual: Elegant stag silhouette, deep coal-black body, antlers erupting into brilliant white-fire branches, ember-glow hoofprints left at each step; stunning at 64px.
signature_idea: Luminary Charge — a sweeping physical-special hybrid Ember/Light attack; signature move
hook: An apex lantern-stag that only appears under the relighting sky — the south's hidden wonder, worth every chase.

name: Cindrake
concept: The apex beast of Cinderhead Mine — a colossal basalt-scaled worm-drake that carves new tunnels with its superheated body as it moves, leaving glowing bore-shafts in its wake.
visual: Long serpentine tunnel-beast silhouette, segmented jet-black basalt-scale plates, lava-orange between every segment, blunt wide drilling-head with four amber eyes; vast at 64px.
signature_idea: Tunnel Fury — bores underground and resurfaces to hit with an unblockable physical Ember/Stone strike
hook: The true master of the mine — the thing that made those deep tunnels, and you can add it to your team.

name: Embralion
concept: A legendary fire-mane predator of the southern warmlands — a great ember-lion whose mane is a permanent aurora of spiralling flame, appearing only as dusk deepens.
visual: Massive lion silhouette, deep amber-red coat, enormous swirling flame-mane with layered orange-to-yellow-to-white bands, heavy powerful paws; regal and immense at 64px.
signature_idea: Aurora Mane — raises all allies' Attack and sets a damaging fire field for three turns
hook: The lion of the eternal dusk — when it appears at sundown, everything falls quiet.

name: Cindle
concept: A small round ember-bear cub that curls into a warm ball when it sleeps and radiates steady heat all night, beloved by travellers sheltering from the cold.
visual: Compact round bear-cub silhouette, rich amber-brown fur, tiny round ears, warm glow emanating from the belly like a lantern; a perfectly cosy shape at 32px.
hook: The warmth-radiating sleeping ball of fluff you want camping beside — pure cosy comfort.

name: Brindlore
concept: A steady, barrel-chested ember-bear whose fur has darkened to brindled auburn and whose every exhale sends glowing motes drifting into the night air.
visual: Broad-shouldered bear silhouette, brindled auburn-and-black fur, warm amber underbelly glow, ember-mote breath cloud; powerful and gentle at 64px.
signature_idea: Ember Breath — AoE fire cone with guaranteed burn chance
hook: The safe, steady power of a campfire incarnate — you feel calmer just having it on your team.

name: Solderling
concept: A cheerful little solar-flame sprite that flits ahead of travellers on the Lanternway like a living lantern-guide, its warm glow lighting the road.
visual: Wispy small orb body, warm gold-and-cream colouring, a cheerful face, short trailing light-ribbon tail, nimble drifting posture; friendly and round at 32px.
hook: The little light-guide that runs ahead to show you the path — heart-warming and actually useful.

name: Glintara
concept: A graceful light-flame dancer who moves faster than the eye can follow, leaving a looping trail of golden light-ribbons that linger for a moment before fading.
visual: Slender ribbon-dancer silhouette, warm gold body, flowing light-ribbon trailing arms, starpoint face-markings, perpetually in mid-leap; elegant and airy at 64px.
signature_idea: Light Trail — sets a field effect that boosts allies' speed for three turns
hook: A living dance of warmth and light — watching it move is joyful all by itself.
